about.heading: About
about.body: Computer scientist at the intersection of machine-learning research and product engineering. Currently writing my M.Sc. thesis on Event–RGB transformer models for end-to-end rodent tracking at LfB, RWTH Aachen. Previously: reinforcement-learning + Bayesian-optimization pipelines for textile process control at RWTH ITA, full-stack web tools used in classrooms, and brain–computer interface software with NeuroTX Aachen e.V.
